trial_court: Learned Additional District Judge, Re-Designated Court, Paschim Medinipore, Judicial Misc. Case No. 159 of 2021
case_name: Dr. Niladri Maiti vs Dr. Swati Das
facts_of_case: Matrimonial Suit for divorce filed by petitioner/husband on 15th September, 2020; ex parte decree of divorce granted on 5th December, 2020; service upon the wife/opposite party is disputed.

legal_principles.principle: Maintainability of an application must be decided before granting interim relief.
legal_principles.held: Whenever maintainability of an application had been grossly challenged, there could not be any interim order granted without deciding the maintainability.
cited_cases: British Airways PLC Vs. Barunendra Nath Basu, (2002) SCC OnLine Cal 7
Director General of Police, Central Reserve Police Force, New Delhi & Ors. Vs. P.M. Ramalingam, (2009) 1 SCC 193
State of West Bengal & Ors. Vs. Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15216112/

legal_principles.principle: A court must consider the maintainability of proceedings before granting an ad interim order of stay.
legal_principles.held: While granting an ad interim order of stay, the maintainability of proceedings incidentally to be taken in view, otherwise there would be abuse of the process of the court leading to flagrant violation of justice.
cited_cases: British Airways PLC Vs. Barunendra Nath Basu, (2002) SCC OnLine Cal 7
Director General of Police, Central Reserve Police Force, New Delhi & Ors. Vs. P.M. Ramalingam, (2009) 1 SCC 193
State of West Bengal & Ors. Vs. Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15216112/

outcome.final_order: Stay of operation of the order granting ex parte decree of divorce was set aside.
